_comment: The single combination VanillaPlusAdditions is actually played on (server 'games2' + Gerry's and Sebi's clients). 'Compatible' means tested; this file is the evidence. Read from the live server's mods folder and logs, not from memory.

compileAgainst._note: gradle.properties neo_version; the runtime is newer - see docs/guides/testing.md

recipeViewer._note: The reference modpack ships NO JEI. Our JEI plugins run through TooManyRecipeViewers, which implements the JEI API on top of EMI. JEI itself is compileOnly (jei_version=19.39.0.368) and untested in this pack.
